sanskrit: aitu devas trāyamāṇaḥ kuṣṭho himavatas pari | takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayan sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
english: Let the god Kuṣṭha, the protector, come hither from beyond the Himavat, destroying all fever and all sorcery-born afflictions.

sanskrit: trīṇi te kuṣṭha nāmāni naghamāro naghāriṣo naghāyuṣo na ghāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat | yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātar atho divā ||
english: Three are thy names, O Kuṣṭha: Naghamāra, Naghāriṣa, Naghāyus — may no man of this sort come to harm. On behalf of him for whom I proclaim thee, evening and morning, and also by day.

sanskrit: jīvalā nāma te mātā jīvanto nāma te pitā māriṣā nāma te svasā na (…) ||
english: Jīvalā by name is thy mother, Jīvanta by name is thy father, Māriṣā by name is thy sister — [and so may no man perish].

sanskrit: uttamo 'sy oṣadhīnām anaḍvāñ jagatām iva vyāghraḥ śvapadām iva na ghāyaṃ puruṣo riṣat | yasmai paribravīmi tvā sāyaṃprātar atho divā ||
english: Thou art the highest among plants, as the bull among cattle, as the tiger among beasts of prey — may no man of this sort come to harm, on behalf of him for whom I proclaim thee, evening and morning, and also by day.

sanskrit: triḥ śāmbubhyo gireyebhyas trir ādityebhyas pari | trir jāto viśvadevebhyaḥ sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati | takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayan sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
english: Born thrice from the Śāmbu-spirits of the mountains, thrice from the Ādityas, thrice born from the Viśvedevas — that Kuṣṭha, the universal remedy, stands together with Soma, destroying all fever and all sorcery-born afflictions.

sanskrit: aśvattho devasadanas tṛtīyasyām ito divi | tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho 'jāyata | saḥ (…) ||
english: The aśvattha tree is the seat of the gods in the third heaven from here; there is the fount of the immortal nectar — from there Kuṣṭha was born. He [is the universal remedy].

sanskrit: hiraṇyayī naur acarad dhiraṇyabandhanā divi (…) ||
english: A golden boat, bound with golden mooring-ropes, coursed through the sky [bearing Kuṣṭha thence].

sanskrit: yatra nāvaḥ prabhraṃśanaṃ yatra himavataḥ śiraḥ | tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ kuṣṭho ajāyata | sa kuṣṭho viśvabheṣajaḥ sākaṃ somena tiṣṭhati | takmānaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayan sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ ||
english: Where the boat alights, where is the summit of the Himavat — there is the fount of the immortal nectar; from there Kuṣṭha was born. That Kuṣṭha, the universal remedy, stands together with Soma, destroying all fever and all sorcery-born afflictions.

sanskrit: yaṃ tvā veda pūrva aikṣvāko yaṃ vā tvā kuṣṭha kāśyaḥ | yaṃ śāvaso yaṃ mātsyas tenāsi viśvabheṣajaḥ ||
english: Thee whom the ancient Aikṣvāka knew, thee whom the Kāśya knew, O Kuṣṭha, whom the Śāvasa knew, whom the Mātsya knew — by that [knowledge] thou art the universal remedy.

sanskrit: śīrṣālākaṃ tṛtīyakaṃ sadandir yaś ca hāyanaḥ | takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīrya- -adharāñcaṃ parā suva ||
english: The headache, the tertian fever, the sadandir, and whatever is the annual fever — drive away downward the takman of every variety, of all-pervading power.

sanskrit: ye parvatāḥ somapṛṣṭhā āpa uttānaśīvarīḥ | vātaḥ parjanya ād agnis te kravyādam aśīśaman ||
english: The mountains whose backs are Soma, the waters that lie spread open, the wind, Parjanya, and Agni — they have appeased the flesh-devouring demon.

sanskrit: yas te hanti carācaram utthāsyantaṃ sarīsṛpam | garbhaṃ yo daśamāsyaṃ tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: That which strikes down whatever moves or is still, whatever is about to rise up, whatever creeps, and the ten-month embryo — that we drive away from here.

sanskrit: yadi ghnanty apsaraso gandharvā gehyā uta | kravyādo mūradevinas tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: If the Apsarasas strike, if the Gandharvas of the household strike, the flesh-devourers, the foolish-deity-followers — those we drive away from here.

sanskrit: yas ta ūrū ārohaty asṛk te rehaṇāya kam | āmādaḥ kravyādo ripūṃs tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: That which mounts thy thighs, lapping thy blood — the raw-flesh-eating, flesh-devouring enemies — those we drive away from here.

sanskrit: yas te śroṇī cyāvayaty antarā dampatī śaye | yoniṃ yo antar āreḍhi tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: That which causes thy hips to fail, which lies between husband and wife at rest, that which licks within the womb — that we drive away from here.

sanskrit: yas tvā svapnena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate | prajāṃ yas te jighatsati tam (…) ||
english: That which, having bewildered thee with the darkness of sleep, falls upon thee, that which desires to devour thy progeny — that [we drive away from here].

sanskrit: yas tvā patyuḥ pratirūpo jāro bhūtvā nipadyate | arāyaṃ kaṇvaṃ pāpmānaṃ tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: That which, assuming the likeness of thy husband, falls upon thee as a lover — that niggard, that blind wretched sinner — that we drive away from here.

sanskrit: hā hai kharva khalate naigūrakarṇa tuṇḍila | indrasya tigmam āyudhaṃ tena tvā nāśayāmasi ||
english: Ha, hai! O crooked one, O bald one, O hidden-eared one, O great-snouted one — with the sharp weapon of Indra we destroy thee.

sanskrit: namas taṇḍāya namaḥ kusumāya namaḥ pratipāvne namaḥ kaḥsvadheye | namas tubhyaṃ nirṛte viśvavāre jaremaṃ dhāpayatāṃ viśvarūpā ||
english: Homage to Taṇḍa, homage to Kusuma, homage to Pratipāva, homage to Kaḥsvadhaya; homage to thee, O Nirṛti, all-desirable one — may she of all forms nourish this man to old age.

sanskrit: yāvad dyaur yāvat pṛthivī yāvat paryeti sūryaḥ | tāvat tvam ugra gulgulo parīmāṃ pāhi viśvataḥ ||
english: As far as the sky extends, as far as the earth, as far as the sun courses round — for that long, O fierce Gulgulu, guard me on all sides from every quarter.

sanskrit: ekarājñīm ekavratām ekasthām ekalāmikām | pāṭāṃ sapatnacātanīṃ jaitrāyācchā vadāmasi ||
english: We address the Pāṭā plant, sole queen, of single vow, dwelling in one place, of single mark — the expeller of rivals — for the sake of victory.

sanskrit: ekarājñy ekavrata ekastha ekalāmike | na tvā sapatnī sāsāha gaireyī ca na bāhyā ||
english: O Pāṭā, sole queen, of single vow, dwelling in one place, of single mark — neither the rival wife born of the mountain nor the one from outside has overcome thee.

sanskrit: uttarāham uttarābhya uttared adharābhyaḥ | adhaḥ sapatnī māmaky adhared adharābhyaḥ ||
english: I am higher than those above, I rise above those below; may my rival wife sink downward, lower than those who are lowest.

sanskrit: na saindhavasya puṣpasya sūryo mlāpayati tvacam | pāṭe 'mlātayā tvayā sapatnyā varca ā dade ||
english: The sun does not wither the skin of the Saindhava flower; with thee, O Pāṭā, who dost not fade, I take the radiance from my rival wife.

sanskrit: na vai pāṭe pāṭevāsi subhāgaṃkaraṇīd asi | pāṭe bhagasya no dhehy atho mā mahiṣīṃ kṛṇu ||
english: Not merely Pāṭā art thou, O Pāṭā — thou art the maker of good fortune; place the boon of Bhaga upon us, O Pāṭā, and moreover make me the chief wife.

sanskrit: yat pāṭe adhi vṛkṣe vātaplavā mahīyase | jayantī pratyātiṣṭhantī saṃjayā nāma vā asi ||
english: Inasmuch as thou, O Pāṭā, dost exalt thyself upon the tree, wave-borne by the wind, standing forward in victory, thy name is indeed Saṃjayā — the all-conquering one.

sanskrit: uttānaparṇāṃ subhagāṃ sahamānāṃ sahasvatīm | acchā bṛhadvadāṃ vada pāṭāṃ sapatnacātanīm ||
english: Speak forth with loud voice to the Pāṭā, whose leaves face upward, the auspicious, the overwhelming, the powerful — the expeller of rivals.

sanskrit: pāṭām indro vy āśnād dhantavā asurebhyaḥ | tayāhaṃ sapatnīṃ sākṣīya mahendro dānavān iva ||
english: Indra spread out the Pāṭā for the purpose of smiting the Asuras; with her may I overcome my rival wife, as great Indra overcame the Dānavas.

sanskrit: pāṭā bibharty aṅkuśaṃ hiraṇyavantam aṅkinam | tena sapatnyā varca ā lumpāmi mamed asat ||
english: Pāṭā bears a golden goad, hook-tipped; with it I strip away the radiance of my rival wife, so that it may be mine.

sanskrit: imāṃ khanāmy oṣadhiṃ vīrudhāṃ balavattamām | yayā sapatnīṃ bādhate kṛṇute kevalaṃ patim ||
english: I dig up this plant, the most powerful of creeping herbs, by which one represses the rival wife and makes the husband hers alone.
